## Rule

Input and output have the same grid size. The input contains a solid filled rectangle (box color), scattered single-pixel dots (dot color), and background. For each dot outside the box: if its row lies inside the box row-span, paint a horizontal dot-color ray from the dot toward the box wall, stopping before the first box cell; if its column lies inside the box column-span, paint the analogous vertical ray; if both row and column are outside the spans (diagonal to the box), emit no ray. Box color, dot color, and background color are data-dependent per grid.
